privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How I Need Convert handles your data and files. Files are converted in your browser and are never uploaded to our servers.
privacy.body:
I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com) is a free tool for converting images, videos, audio, documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, and data, run by Abid Hanan Wicaksono. This policy explains what data is processed when you use this website and how we handle it. We deliberately collect as little data as possible: you don't need to sign up, log in, or give us your name or email to use the service.

Files you convert

All conversions run directly in your browser. The files you select are read and processed by your own device, and the results are saved straight to your device. Your files and their contents are never uploaded to our servers, are not stored by us, and cannot be seen by us. Once you close or reload the page, the files are cleared from your browser's memory.

Data we process

  • Technical data. Like almost every website, our hosting provider (Cloudflare) logs technical request data, such as IP address, browser type, and access time, for security and operational purposes. These logs are kept only temporarily, in line with Cloudflare's policies.
  • Article statistics. View, like, and share counts are stored as totals per article, without any data that identifies you.

Cookies and browser storage

  • inc-lang (localStorage): remembers the language you chose. This data stays on your device.
  • Third-party analytics cookies from Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, described below.
  • Local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage): remembers the articles you liked and stops one visit from being counted twice. This data stays on your device.

Analytics

We use analytics tools to understand how the website is used and to improve it:

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): uses cookies to measure the pages you open, your approximate country, your device type, and events such as clicks on download buttons. The data is processed by Google under the Google Privacy Policy.
  • Microsoft Clarity: loaded once you start interacting with the page. Clarity records interactions such as clicks and scrolling for heatmaps and session recordings, and masks what you type into input fields. The data is processed by Microsoft under the Microsoft Privacy Statement.

You can opt out of analytics by blocking third-party cookies in your browser settings, using a tracker blocker, or installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. The website remains fully usable.

Third-party services

  • Cloudflare, Inc. provides hosting. Its servers may be located outside Indonesia.
  • jsDelivr serves the video and audio conversion engine. The engine is downloaded to your browser the first time you convert a video or audio file, so your IP address is visible to jsDelivr. Your files are not sent along with it.
  • Google Fonts is used to display certain scripts (for example Arabic, Thai, or Japanese). When the fonts load, your IP address is visible to Google.
  • Share buttons (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) only contact those services when you click them.

Security and data sharing

All connections to this website use HTTPS. We don't sell, rent, or trade personal data. Data is shared only with the service providers listed above to the extent needed to run the website, or when required by law.

Children

This service is not directed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect personal data from children.

Your rights

Under Indonesia's Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, and to withdraw your consent to its processing. Because we store almost no data that identifies you, most requests can be handled simply by clearing this site's data in your browser settings. For any other requests, please contact us.

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. Changes take effect once published on this page, with the effective date shown at the top.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent via the contact link at the bottom of every page or through abidhanan.my.id.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using I Need Convert, a free tool for converting files in your browser.
terms.body:
By using I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com), you agree to the following terms and conditions. If you don't agree, please don't use this service.

About the service

I Need Convert is a free tool for converting files from one format to another. Conversions run in your browser, so your files are not uploaded to our servers. I Need Convert is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Apple, Microsoft, Google, Adobe, or any other format or brand owner. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Permitted use

  • Only convert files that you own, that you have permission to use, or that you are allowed to use under applicable law.
  • You may use this service for both personal and work purposes, as long as you comply with these terms.

Your files and your responsibility

The files you convert remain yours or belong to their rights holders. You are fully responsible for the files you select and for how you use the converted results. Always keep a copy of the original file before converting.

What's not allowed

  • Converting or distributing content that violates the law, copyright, or other people's privacy.
  • Using this service to break copy protection (DRM) or other technical restrictions.
  • Using bots, scripts, or automation to access the service at scale.
  • Disrupting, overloading, or attempting to breach the security of our website and services.

Conversion results

We do our best to make conversions as good as possible, but not every format can be converted perfectly. Layout, images, tables, formulas, metadata, or quality may change or be lost, depending on the source and target formats. Check the results before you use them for anything important.

Service availability

The service is provided free of charge and may be changed, limited, or discontinued at any time without notice. Some formats depend on the capabilities of your browser and device, so not every conversion is always available.

Disclaimer

The service is provided "as is" and "as available", without any warranty, including any warranty that the service will always work, be error-free, or be fit for a particular purpose.

Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any direct or indirect loss arising from the use of this service, including loss of or damage to data and files.

Third-party links

This website contains links to third-party sites and services. We are not responsible for the content or policies of those sites.

Changes to these terms

These terms and conditions may be updated from time to time. By continuing to use the service after changes are published, you are deemed to accept the latest version.

Governing law

These terms and conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

Contact

Questions and reports can be sent via the contact link at the bottom of every page or through abidhanan.my.id. Please also read our Privacy Policy.
